summary: Verified 3 SQL migration download endpoints via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 6 pytest cases pass. Resources migration file served intact (48 INSERTs, ends with ');', contains 'NAMI Central Virginia'), notary migration contains the notary_requests CREATE TABLE, and the pre-existing candles endpoint still returns 200 (regression clean).
critical_code_review_comments: Review request states resources file should have '51 INSERT statements (48 seed + CREATE TABLE + CREATE INDEX = 3 non-INSERT)'. The wording is inconsistent — the file actually has 48 INSERT statements plus 1 CREATE TABLE + 1 CREATE INDEX (2 non-INSERT DDL). Test asserts 48 INSERTs which matches the actual file. No code bug; just a spec-vs-file wording nit.

The three FileResponse endpoints hardcode absolute paths under /app/cf-dashboard-deploy/. Consider centralising via a constant / Path(__file__).parent-relative resolution so the endpoints don't 500 if the app is relocated. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: N/A — endpoints are public, no auth required
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend download endpoints /api/download/{resources,notary,candles}-migration-sql all verified via public URL. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_download_sql.py is idempotent and safe to re-run.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration validates a fix, no bug reproduced. Truncation-during-copy-paste was a client-side D1 console limitation; the added FileResponse endpoints stream the full file so users can Save-As instead.
